General Information
New in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Cir-Clip (C-Clip) for the Transfer Case Input & Output Shafts
This C-Clip is part of the Gear System and attaches to the Input & Output Shafts
The T-Case Requires 2 of the C-Clips.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – C-Clip
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1990 – 1995 All Models
